class.name: TerrainConfig
class.brief_description: Serializable resource for complete terrain generation configuration.
class.description:
[b]TerrainConfig[/b] is a [Resource]-based preset container that stores all terrain generation parameters and can be reused across multiple VoxelGenerator instances.
[b]Key Features:[/b] [ul] [li]Serializable to .tres files for easy sharing and version control[/li] [li]Contains world structure, generation parameters, and references to biome/feature generators[/li] [li]Can be applied to any VoxelGenerator via [method apply_to_voxel_generator][/li] [li]Inspector-friendly with clear property categories[/li] [/ul]
[b]Architecture:[/b] A TerrainConfig aggregates all the settings needed to generate terrain: - World structure: world_size, chunk_size - Generation parameters: resolution, cutoff, terrain_height, terrain_amplitude, rock_influence - Noise configuration: noise_generator reference - Biome configuration: biome_generator reference - LOD settings: lod_levels - Rendering: terrain_material, use_textures
[b]Typical Usage:[/b] [code] # Create and configure in editor or code var config = TerrainConfig.new() config.set_config_name("Mountains") config.set_world_size(Vector3i(16, 16, 16)) config.set_chunk_size(8) config.set_terrain_height(20.0) config.set_terrain_amplitude(15.0)
# Create noise var noise = NoiseGenerator.new() noise.set_period(64.0) config.set_noise_generator(noise)
# Save for reuse ResourceSaver.save(config, "res://configs/mountains.tres")
# Later: load and apply var saved_config = ResourceLoader.load("res://configs/mountains.tres") var generator = VoxelGenerator.new() add_child(generator) saved_config.apply_to_voxel_generator(generator) generator.generate() [/code]
[b]Related Classes:[/b] [ul] [li][VoxelGenerator] - Engine that uses this configuration[/li] [li][NoiseGenerator] - Noise implementation reference[/li] [li][BiomeGenerator] - Biome system reference[/li] [li][BiomePreset] - Individual biome configuration[/li] [li][VoxelEngine] - Can load configs via [method VoxelEngine.load_terrain][/li] [/ul]
[b]Directory Layout:[/b] Store configs in [code]res://configs/[/code] for organization. The [method VoxelEngine.load_terrain] method expects this structure.

method.name: set_config_name
method.description:
Sets the configuration name (metadata).
[b]Parameters:[/b] [code]p_name[/code] - String identifier for this configuration (e.g., "Mountains", "Desert", "Flatlands").
[b]Effect:[/b] Used for organization and documentation. No effect on generation.
[b]Example:[/b] [code] config.set_config_name("Tropical Biome") [/code]
[b]See Also:[/b] [method get_config_name]

method.name: get_config_name
method.description:
Returns the configuration name.
[b]See Also:[/b] [method set_config_name]

method.name: set_world_size
method.description:
Sets the world grid dimensions (in chunks).
[b]Parameters:[/b] [code]p_size[/code] - Grid size as Vector3i. Default (5, 5, 5).
[b]Effect:[/b] When applied to a generator, sets [method VoxelGenerator.set_world_size].
[b]Example:[/b] [code] config.set_world_size(Vector3i(16, 16, 16)) # 16×16×16 chunks [/code]
[b]See Also:[/b] [method get_world_size], [method set_chunk_size]

method.name: get_world_size
method.description:
Returns the configured world size (in chunks).
[b]See Also:[/b] [method set_world_size]

method.name: set_chunk_size
method.description:
Sets the chunk dimensions (voxels per chunk edge).
[b]Parameters:[/b] [code]p_size[/code] - Size. Default 8. Common values: 4, 8, 16, 32, 64.
[b]Effect:[/b] When applied, sets [method VoxelGenerator.set_chunk_size].
[b]Example:[/b] [code] config.set_chunk_size(16) # Larger chunks = fewer total [/code]
[b]See Also:[/b] [method get_chunk_size], [method set_world_size]

method.name: get_chunk_size
method.description:
Returns the configured chunk size.
[b]See Also:[/b] [method set_chunk_size]

method.name: set_resolution
method.description:
Sets the sampling resolution (samples per voxel edge).
[b]Parameters:[/b] [code]p_resolution[/code] - Resolution level. Default 2. Range: 1-3 typical.
[b]Effect:[/b] When applied, sets [method VoxelGenerator.set_resolution]. Higher = smoother surface but slower generation.
[b]Example:[/b] [code] config.set_resolution(1) # Fast, blocky [/code]
[b]See Also:[/b] [method get_resolution]

method.name: get_resolution
method.description:
Returns the configured resolution.
[b]See Also:[/b] [method set_resolution]

method.name: set_cutoff
method.description:
Sets the marching cubes density cutoff threshold.
[b]Parameters:[/b] [code]p_cutoff[/code] - Threshold value. Default 0.1. Negative = more solid, positive = more air.
[b]Effect:[/b] When applied, sets [method VoxelGenerator.set_cutoff].
[b]Example:[/b] [code] config.set_cutoff(-0.2) # More solid terrain [/code]
[b]See Also:[/b] [method get_cutoff]

method.name: get_cutoff
method.description:
Returns the configured cutoff threshold.
[b]See Also:[/b] [method set_cutoff]

method.name: set_seeder
method.description:
Sets the random seed for noise generation.
[b]Parameters:[/b] [code]p_seeder[/code] - Seed integer. Default 1240. Same seed produces identical terrain.
[b]Effect:[/b] When applied, sets [method VoxelGenerator.set_seeder].
[b]Example:[/b] [code] config.set_seeder(42) [/code]
[b]See Also:[/b] [method get_seeder]

method.name: get_seeder
method.description:
Returns the configured seed.
[b]See Also:[/b] [method set_seeder]

method.name: set_terrain_height
method.description:
Sets the base terrain height (center height of terrain).
[b]Parameters:[/b] [code]p_height[/code] - Height in world units. Default 4.0.
[b]Effect:[/b] When applied, sets [method VoxelGenerator.set_terrain_height].
[b]Example:[/b] [code] config.set_terrain_height(20.0) # Terrain centered at Y=20 [/code]
[b]See Also:[/b] [method get_terrain_height], [method set_terrain_amplitude]

method.name: get_terrain_height
method.description:
Returns the configured terrain height.
[b]See Also:[/b] [method set_terrain_height]

method.name: set_terrain_amplitude
method.description:
Sets the terrain height variation range.
[b]Parameters:[/b] [code]p_amplitude[/code] - Amplitude in world units. Default 8.0. Larger = more dramatic height variation.
[b]Effect:[/b] When applied, sets [method VoxelGenerator.set_terrain_amplitude].
[b]Example:[/b] [code] config.set_terrain_amplitude(25.0) # Mountainous [/code]
[b]See Also:[/b] [method get_terrain_amplitude], [method set_terrain_height]

method.name: get_terrain_amplitude
method.description:
Returns the configured terrain amplitude.
[b]See Also:[/b] [method set_terrain_amplitude]

method.name: set_terrain_material
method.description:
Sets the material applied to terrain chunks.
[b]Parameters:[/b] [code]p_material[/code] - A [Material] resource (StandardMaterial3D, ShaderMaterial, etc.).
[b]Effect:[/b] When applied, sets [method VoxelGenerator.set_terrain_material].
[b]Example:[/b] [code] var mat = StandardMaterial3D.new() mat.albedo_color = Color.DARK_SLATE_GRAY config.set_terrain_material(mat) [/code]
[b]See Also:[/b] [method get_terrain_material], [method set_use_textures]

method.name: get_terrain_material
method.description:
Returns the configured terrain material.
[b]See Also:[/b] [method set_terrain_material]

method.name: set_use_textures
method.description:
Sets whether to use textures for rendering.
[b]Parameters:[/b] [code]p_use_textures[/code] - true for textured, false for vertex colors. Default true.
[b]Effect:[/b] When applied, sets [method VoxelGenerator.set_use_textures].
[b]See Also:[/b] [method get_use_textures], [method set_terrain_material]

method.name: get_use_textures
method.description:
Returns whether textures are enabled.
[b]See Also:[/b] [method set_use_textures]

method.name: set_noise_generator
method.description:
Sets the noise generator reference for base terrain height.
[b]Parameters:[/b] [code]p_noise_generator[/code] - A [NoiseGenerator] resource.
[b]Effect:[/b] When applied, sets [method VoxelGenerator.set_terrain_noise].
[b]Example:[/b] [code] var noise = NoiseGenerator.new() noise.set_period(64.0) noise.set_octaves(6) config.set_noise_generator(noise) [/code]
[b]See Also:[/b] [method get_noise_generator], [method NoiseGenerator]

method.name: get_noise_generator
method.description:
Returns the configured noise generator reference.
[b]See Also:[/b] [method set_noise_generator]

method.name: set_biome_generator
method.description:
Sets the biome generator reference.
[b]Parameters:[/b] [code]p_biome_generator[/code] - A [BiomeGenerator] resource with configured biomes.
[b]Effect:[/b] When applied, sets [method VoxelGenerator.set_biome_generator].
[b]Example:[/b] [code] var biome_gen = BiomeGenerator.new() # Configure biomes... config.set_biome_generator(biome_gen) [/code]
[b]See Also:[/b] [method get_biome_generator], [method BiomeGenerator]

method.name: get_biome_generator
method.description:
Returns the configured biome generator reference.
[b]See Also:[/b] [method set_biome_generator]

method.name: set_rock_influence
method.description:
Sets the strength of detail noise (rocky features).
[b]Parameters:[/b] [code]p_influence[/code] - Blend factor 0.0-1.0. Default 0.3.
[b]Effect:[/b] When applied, sets [method VoxelGenerator.set_rock_influence].
[b]Example:[/b] [code] config.set_rock_influence(0.5) # Moderate roughness [/code]
[b]See Also:[/b] [method get_rock_influence]

method.name: get_rock_influence
method.description:
Returns the configured rock influence.
[b]See Also:[/b] [method set_rock_influence]

method.name: set_sea_level
method.description:
Sets the sea level (for biome calculations).
[b]Parameters:[/b] [code]p_level[/code] - Y-coordinate of sea level. Default 0.0. Used for water biome areas.
[b]Effect:[/b] Referenced by biome system for determining which areas are underwater vs above-water.
[b]Example:[/b] [code] config.set_sea_level(5.0) # Water at Y=5 [/code]
[b]See Also:[/b] [method get_sea_level]

method.name: get_sea_level
method.description:
Returns the configured sea level.
[b]See Also:[/b] [method set_sea_level]

method.name: set_lod_levels
method.description:
Sets the number of LOD levels (0-7).
[b]Parameters:[/b] [code]p_levels[/code] - Number of LOD levels. Default 6. Range: 1-8.
[b]Effect:[/b] Configuration parameter for documentation. LOD system depends on both this and per-generator settings.
[b]See Also:[/b] [method get_lod_levels]

method.name: get_lod_levels
method.description:
Returns the configured LOD level count.
[b]See Also:[/b] [method set_lod_levels]

method.name: set_biome_presets
method.description:
Sets the array of biome presets.
[b]Parameters:[/b] [code]p_presets[/code] - Array of [BiomePreset] resources.
[b]Effect:[/b] Storage for preset configurations that can be applied to the biome generator.
[b]Example:[/b] [code] var presets = [] # Add presets... config.set_biome_presets(presets) [/code]
[b]See Also:[/b] [method get_biome_presets], [method get_biome_preset]

method.name: get_biome_presets
method.description:
Returns the array of biome presets.
[b]See Also:[/b] [method set_biome_presets]

method.name: get_biome_preset
method.description:
Gets a specific biome preset by index.
[b]Parameters:[/b] [code]p_index[/code] - Index in presets array.
[b]Return Value:[/b] The [BiomePreset] at that index, or null if out of bounds.
[b]Example:[/b] [code] var preset = config.get_biome_preset(0) if preset != null: print("Preset name: ", preset.get_name()) [/code]
[b]See Also:[/b] [method get_biome_preset_count], [method get_biome_presets]

method.name: get_biome_preset_count
method.description:
Returns the number of biome presets.
[b]Return Value:[/b] Count of presets in array.
[b]Example:[/b] [code] for i in range(config.get_biome_preset_count()): var preset = config.get_biome_preset(i) [/code]
[b]See Also:[/b] [method get_biome_preset], [method set_biome_presets]

method.name: apply_to_voxel_generator
method.description:
Applies all stored configuration to a [VoxelGenerator] instance.
[b]Parameters:[/b] [code]p_generator[/code] - A [VoxelGenerator] instance (passed as Object for binding flexibility).
[b]Return Value:[/b] true if successfully applied, false on error (e.g., invalid generator type).
[b]Effect:[/b] Sets all properties on the generator: [ul] [li][method VoxelGenerator.set_world_size][/li] [li][method VoxelGenerator.set_chunk_size][/li] [li][method VoxelGenerator.set_resolution][/li] [li][method VoxelGenerator.set_cutoff][/li] [li][method VoxelGenerator.set_seeder][/li] [li][method VoxelGenerator.set_terrain_height][/li] [li][method VoxelGenerator.set_terrain_amplitude][/li] [li][method VoxelGenerator.set_rock_influence][/li] [li][method VoxelGenerator.set_terrain_noise][/li] [li][method VoxelGenerator.set_biome_generator][/li] [li][method VoxelGenerator.set_terrain_material][/li] [/ul]
[b]Typical Usage:[/b] [code] var generator = VoxelGenerator.new() add_child(generator) if config.apply_to_voxel_generator(generator): generator.generate_async() [/code]
[b]See Also:[/b] [method VoxelEngine.load_terrain]
